theorem correction_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :

theorem sum_correction (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

theorem correction_power_bound :

statements.name: InverseTotient320.reciprocal_sq_tail

statements.header:
theorem reciprocal_sq_tail (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (s : Finset ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ r ∈ s, x < (r : ℝ)) :
    (∑ r ∈ s, 1 / (r : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ 2 / x

statements.name: InverseTotient320.inverse_totient_sq_tail
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem inverse_totient_sq_tail :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ P : ℝ, 0 < P → ∀ s : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ n ∈ s, 0 < n ∧ P < (n : ℝ)) →
      (∑ n ∈ s, 1 / (n.totient : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ K / P

statements.name: Tail320.finite_totient_tail
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem finite_totient_tail (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (P K : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hK : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ t : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ r ∈ t, 0 < r ∧ x < (r : ℝ)) →
      (∑ r ∈ t, 1 / (r.totient : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ K / x)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, 0 < q ∧ P < (q : ℝ)) :
    (∑ q ∈ s, 1 / ((q.totient : ℝ) * (q / Nat.gcd q m).totient)) ≤
      K / P * ((m : ℝ) * m.divisors.card / m.totient)

statements.name: Tail320.finite_ramanujan_tail
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem finite_ramanujan_tail (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (P K : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hK : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ t : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ r ∈ t, 0 < r ∧ x < (r : ℝ)) →
      (∑ r ∈ t, 1 / (r.totient : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ K / x)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, 0 < q ∧ P < (q : ℝ)) :
    ‖∑ q ∈ s, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℂ) ^ 2) *
      RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt q (-(m : ℤ))‖ ≤
      K / P * ((m : ℝ) * m.divisors.card / m.totient)

theorem sum_norm_tail (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ P : ℝ, 0 < P → ∀ s : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ q ∈ s, 0 < q ∧ P < (q : ℝ)) →
      (∑ q ∈ s, ‖coefficient m q‖) ≤
        K / P * ((m : ℝ) * m.divisors.card / m.totient)

theorem partial_tail :

      ‖(Sing m : ℂ) - ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊P⌋₊, coefficient m q‖ ≤
        K * ((m : ℝ) * m.divisors.card / m.totient) / P

theorem window_pos (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℝ, 3 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N → ∀ n ∈ win F N H,
      0 < (Fv F n).toNat

statements.name: Decomp320a.leaf_finite_major
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem leaf_finite_major (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (A ε B : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) (hB : 0 < B) :
    ∃ C N₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 3 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N →
      N ^ (1 / (3 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
      H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ)) →
      (∀ n ∈ win F N H, 0 ≤ Fv F n ∧ (Fv F n).toNat ≤ ⌊c * N⌋₊) →
      ∀ n ∈ win F N H,
      ‖(∫ α in Set.Icc 0 1 ∩ majorArcs N B,
          coefficientIntegrand ⌊c * N⌋₊ (Fv F n).toNat α) -
        (Fv F n : ℂ) * singularPartial (Fv F n).toNat (Real.log N ^ B)‖ ≤
        C * N * (Real.log N ^ (1 - B) + Real.log N ^ (-A / 2))

statements.name: Decomp320a.leaf_singular_tail
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem leaf_singular_tail :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∀ P : ℝ, 1 ≤ P →
      ‖(Sing m : ℂ) - singularPartial m P‖ ≤
        C * ((m : ℝ) * m.divisors.card / m.totient) / P

statements.name: Decomp320a.leaf_major_pointwise
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem leaf_major_pointwise (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (A ε B : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) (hB : 0 < B) :
    ∃ C N₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 3 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N →
      N ^ (1 / (3 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
      H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ)) →
      (∀ n ∈ win F N H, 0 ≤ Fv F n ∧ (Fv F n).toNat ≤ ⌊c * N⌋₊) →
      ∀ n ∈ win F N H,
      ‖(∫ α in Set.Icc 0 1 ∩ majorArcs N B,
          coefficientIntegrand ⌊c * N⌋₊ (Fv F n).toNat α) -
        ((Fv F n : ℝ) * Sing (Fv F n).toNat : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        C * N ^ 2 * (Real.log N ^ (-2 * B) * majorWeight (Fv F n).toNat N ^ 2 +
          Real.log N ^ (-A))

statements.header:
theorem full_coefficient (M m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ M) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Kernel.T 0 (M + 1) α ^ 2 * Kernel.e (-(m : ℝ) * α)) = (m + 1 : ℂ)

statements.header:
theorem centered_coefficient (M m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ M) :
    (∫ α in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
      Kernel.T 0 (M + 1) α ^ 2 * Kernel.e (-(m : ℝ) * α)) = (m + 1 : ℂ)

statements.name: PrincipalTail320.central_coefficient_error
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem central_coefficient_error (M m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ M) (δ : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ‖(∫ α in (-δ)..δ, Kernel.T 0 (M + 1) α ^ 2 * Kernel.e (-(m : ℝ) * α)) - (m : ℂ)‖ ≤
      1 + 1 / (2 * δ)

theorem ratio_eq_product (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

theorem sum_norm_le_ratio :

statements.name: PrincipalModel320.finite_model_error
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem finite_model_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ m M : ℕ, 0 < m → m ≤ M → ∀ s : Finset ℕ,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      ‖(∑ q ∈ s, Series320.coefficient m q) *
          (∫ α in (-δ)..δ, Kernel.T 0 (M + 1) α ^ 2 * Kernel.e (-(m : ℝ) * α)) -
        (m : ℂ) * (∑ q ∈ s, Series320.coefficient m q)‖ ≤
        C * (1 + Real.log m) * (1 + 1 / (2 * δ))

statements.name: PrincipalModel320.finite_model_error_scaled
statements.variant: Explicit derived arithmetic or inclusive endpoint variant as recorded in STATEMENTS.md
statements.header:
theorem finite_model_error_scaled (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ N P : ℝ, Real.exp 1 ≤ N → 0 < P → P / N ≤ 1 / 2 →
      ∀ m M : ℕ, 0 < m → m ≤ M → (m : ℝ) ≤ c * N → ∀ s : Finset ℕ,
      ‖(∑ q ∈ s, Series320.coefficient m q) *
          (∫ α in (-(P / N))..(P / N), Kernel.T 0 (M + 1) α ^ 2 * Kernel.e (-(m : ℝ) * α)) -
        (m : ℂ) * (∑ q ∈ s, Series320.coefficient m q)‖ ≤
        C * N * Real.log N / P
